# Terms of Use

_Effective October 9, 2026_

These Terms of Use ("Terms") apply to your use of the Longstead app ("Longstead" or the "App"), published by Core Hermit ("we", "us", "the developer"), for iPhone and Mac. If you get the App from the App Store or TestFlight, your license to use it is granted under Apple's Licensed Application End User License Agreement (https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/) (the "Standard EULA"). These Terms supplement whichever applies; if they conflict, the Standard EULA or the Software License Agreement controls to the extent required. By using the App you agree to these Terms.

## 1. What the App does
Longstead helps you organize your retirement accounts and explore scenarios: it estimates taxes, required minimum distributions, Social Security timing, withdrawal order, and the odds a plan lasts, using calculators and Monte Carlo simulation, and it offers AI advisors that discuss the results. Calculations and AI features run on your device.

## 2. Not financial, tax, legal, or investment advice; no fiduciary duty
The App is an educational planning tool. **It does not provide financial, tax, legal, accounting, or investment advice**, and we are not a registered investment adviser, broker, tax preparer, accountant, attorney, or fiduciary. Using the App does not create an advisory, professional, or fiduciary relationship between you and us. Results are estimates based on the information you enter and on simplified assumptions (for example, constant real-dollar spending, a fixed return distribution, and tax tables that may be out of date or omit some rules, credits, and surtaxes). They are not guarantees or predictions. Consult a qualified professional before making financial or tax decisions. See the Financial Disclaimer.

## 3. AI-generated content
Advisor answers are generated automatically by AI and may be inaccurate, incomplete, outdated, or inconsistent with the calculators. Where the App computes a figure with its own tools, prefer that figure. The App's figure check is a safeguard and not a guarantee (see the AI Disclaimer). You are solely responsible for evaluating AI output and for any decision you make based on it.

## 4. Your information and your responsibility
You are responsible for the accuracy of the information you enter and for keeping backups of anything important, because your data is stored only on your device and the App asks the system to exclude it from backups. The App's export feature can help.

You agree not to use the App to break any law, to infringe anyone's rights, to reverse engineer it except as the law allows, or to violate Apple's acceptable use requirements for its Foundation Models. Do not use the App or its output to provide professional advice to others as a business.
